column1: # Quarkus signal catalog for scan.sh --framework quarkus. Tab-separated: id, category, since, scope, ERE pattern, note.
# category: removed (breaks compile/run from <since>), renamed (artifact, package or config key renamed at <since>; quarkus update
#           usually rewrites it), deprecated (warns from <since>), behavior (semantics change at <since>).
# since: dotted Quarkus stream where the change lands (3.9). scope: java (*.java), build (pom.xml, *.gradle*, gradle.properties),
# Range rule (scan.sh --framework quarkus --from F --to T): every category when F < since <= T.
# Sources: wiki Migration-Guide-<since>. Patterns are POSIX ERE without \b or \s so rg and grep -E agree.

column6: 2.14: io.quarkus.arc.config.ConfigProperties removed. Use @io.smallrye.config.ConfigMapping
Jakarta EE 10: javax.* EE packages become jakarta.* (javax.transaction.xa and other JDK javax.* stay). quarkus update rewrites imports; check reflection strings and XML descriptors by hand
Hibernate ORM 5.6 to 6.2: API and behavior changes that the recipes do not cover. See the Hibernate ORM 5 to 6 guide and references/2.13-to-3.2.md
Hibernate ORM 6: legacy Criteria API removed. Port to the JPA Criteria API

Hibernate ORM 6: version-specific dialects deprecated, QuarkusH2Dialect removed, some moved to hibernate-community-dialects. Remove the setting or use the version-independent class; set quarkus.datasource.db-version
3.0: @AlternativePriority removed. Use @Alternative plus @Priority (jakarta.annotation.Priority)
3.0: quarkus.opentelemetry.* deprecated for quarkus.otel.*; sampler values renamed (on to always_on, ratio to traceidratio) and not mapped automatically
3.0: JDBC tracing via jdbc:otel: URL and OpenTelemetryDriver replaced by quarkus.datasource.jdbc.telemetry=true
3.0: @NativeImageTest and @DisabledOnNativeImageTest removed. Use @QuarkusIntegrationTest and @DisabledOnIntegrationTest
3.0: Mutiny.Session can no longer be injected. Inject Mutiny.SessionFactory and use withSession()/withTransaction()

3.6: Jaeger and SmallRye OpenTracing left the platform for Quarkiverse (io.quarkiverse.jaeger, io.quarkiverse.opentracing, explicit version). quarkus update rewrites them; plan a move to OpenTelemetry
3.7: RESTEasy Classic clients quarkus-rest-client* renamed to quarkus-resteasy-client*. From 3.9 the old names mean the reactive client, so rename before crossing 3.9
3.7: with Hibernate ORM 6.4 jpamodelgen must be an annotation processor (Maven annotationProcessorPaths with compiler plugin 3.12.0+, Gradle annotationProcessor), not a provided dependency
3.9: RESTEasy Reactive extensions renamed to quarkus-rest* and quarkus-rest-client*. quarkus update rewrites them; Maven relocations cover the old names for now
3.9: config roots quarkus.resteasy-reactive.* and quarkus.rest-client-reactive.* become quarkus.rest.* and quarkus.rest-client.*
3.9: SmallRye Reactive Messaging extensions renamed to quarkus-messaging*. quarkus update rewrites them; Maven relocations cover the old names
3.9: config root quarkus.smallrye-reactive-messaging.* becomes quarkus.messaging.* (old keys fall back for now)
3.9: the Panache annotation processor is gone; remove io.quarkus:quarkus-panache-common from annotationProcessorPaths / annotationProcessor
3.10: Flyway 10 moves database support into modules; add org.flywaydb:flyway-database-<db> (for example flyway-database-postgresql)
3.10: packaging keys moved under quarkus.package.jar.*; quarkus.package.type becomes quarkus.package.jar.type or quarkus.native.enabled=true. Old keys warn
3.11: ProfileManager removed. Use ConfigUtils#getProfiles, or LaunchMode.current().getProfileKey() for the key
3.12: quarkus.opentelemetry.* keys removed. Use quarkus.otel.*; sampler is quarkus.otel.traces.sampler with always_on, always_off, traceidratio (parentbased_* variants)
3.13: io.opentelemetry.extension.annotations.WithSpan removed. Use io.opentelemetry.instrumentation.annotations.WithSpan
3.17: OpenTracing removed, including BOM entries. Move to OpenTelemetry (telemetry-opentracing-to-otel-tutorial guide)
3.23: deprecated io.quarkus.test.junit.mockito.InjectMock removed. Use io.quarkus.test.InjectMock
3.23: quarkus.hibernate-orm.database.generation* renamed to quarkus.hibernate-orm.schema-management.*. quarkus update rewrites it
3.24: Hibernate ORM 7.0 / Jakarta Persistence 3.2. API removals and behavior changes; see references/3.20-to-3.27.md
3.24: ORM 7 annotation processor is org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-processor (org.hibernate.processor.HibernateProcessor)
3.24: ORM 7 removed Hibernate @Table, @Where, @WhereJoinTable, @OrderBy, @Index, @IndexColumn and changed @Proxy. Use JPA annotations, @SQLRestriction, @SQLOrder, @OrderColumn, @ConcreteProxy
3.26: config keys ending .enable renamed to .enabled; old keys deprecated. quarkus update rewrites them
3.26: legacy config classes gone. Extensions need @ConfigMapping interfaces; use DevServicesConfig, VertxHttpConfig, VertxHttpBuildTimeConfig; upgrade Quarkiverse extensions
3.28: quarkus.http.cors removed (deprecated 3.19). Use quarkus.http.cors.enabled
3.30: Apache Derby support removed; artifacts no longer published
3.31: JUnit 6; quarkus-junit5* artifacts renamed to quarkus-junit*. quarkus update rewrites them; relocations exist
3.31: SmallRye Metrics extension removed. See the Quarkus Observability Roadmap 2023 post
3.31: quarkus.https.port and quarkus.https.test-port removed. Use quarkus.http.ssl-port and quarkus.http.test-ssl-port
3.35: @Transactional REST endpoints are no longer forced onto a worker thread. A method returning Uni runs on the event loop; add @Blocking if it blocks
3.35: kafka-native Dev Services provider deprecated; use upstream-kafka-native (now the default)
3.36: TLS provider types moved to io.quarkus.tls in quarkus-tls-registry-spi; old classes are gone
3.37: Panache Next renamed to Quarkus Data (quarkus-data-hibernate). quarkus update rewrites the dependency
3.38: LateBoundSpanProcessor removed (deprecated in 3.36). Use SpanProcessorCustomizer
3.38: Host header must be a localhost name when quarkus.http.host is localhost. Behind a proxy set quarkus.http.host-validation.allowed-hosts
3.38: low-level client switched to co.elastic.clients.transport.rest5_client.low_level.Rest5Client (Apache HTTP client 5)
3.38: AMQP Dev Services image moved to quay.io/arkmq-org/arkmq-org-broker with artemis.X.Y.Z tags
3.38: FileUpload#fileName() is sanitized (path stripped) and may return null; no switch restores the old value
4.0: Jackson 3 moves com.fasterxml.jackson.core/databind to tools.jackson.core/databind (annotations stay). quarkus update runs UpgradeJackson_2_3; check custom serializers
4.0: ObjectMapperCustomizer renamed to JsonMapperBuilderCustomizer, which receives a JsonMapper.Builder instead of an ObjectMapper
4.0: @DefaultBean deprecated for removal; replace with @jakarta.enterprise.inject.Reserve plus @Priority(0). quarkus update rewrites it
4.0: Prometheus client 1.x. io.micrometer.prometheus becomes io.micrometer.prometheusmetrics, CollectorRegistry becomes PrometheusRegistry, ExemplarSampler becomes SpanContext
4.0: relocations dropped. Use quarkus-junit*, quarkus-web-dependency-locator, quarkus-hibernate-search-orm-outbox-polling (quarkus-junit5 relocation kept for now). quarkus update rewrites them
4.0: Hibernate ORM 8 removed QueryHints. Use HibernateHints or SpecHints constants; AvailableHints.getDefinedHints()
4.0: config properties deprecated before 3.33 are removed. See the Config table in references/3.40-to-4.0.md for replacements
4.0: separate gRPC server removed. Services run on the HTTP server; use quarkus.http.port and quarkus.http.ssl.certificate.files/key-files
4.0: sql-load-script deprecated. Split into schema-management.init-script (schema.sql) and data-management.init-script (data.sql); import.sql next to them fails the build
4.0: H2DatabaseTestResource deprecated. Dev Services start in-process H2 when db-kind=h2 and no JDBC URL is set
4.0: OTLP default protocol http/protobuf on 4318 (was grpc on 4317), trace sampling 10% in prod/test, OTel metrics and logs on by default
4.0: legacy OIDC config APIs removed. Use OidcTenantConfig.builder() and io.quarkus.oidc.client.runtime.OidcClientConfig.builder()
